parameters.name: AuthorizationId
parameters.description:
The project authorization ID.
> You can call the ListProjectAuthorizations operation to query this parameter.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID of the bastion host.
> You can invoke the [DescribeInstances](~~153281~~) operation to query this parameter.

parameters.name: PrincipalIds
parameters.description:
The array of project administrator IDs to remove.
> You can call the GetProjectAuthorization operation to query this parameter.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the bastion host.
> For the mapping between region IDs and region names, see [Regions and zones](~~40654~~).
